ftl_daughtercraft.cryo: 150 kW-class at 20 K; metric NORMAL needs 3.5 MW cryo electrical and 106 m2 of 900 K radiator (HARD 23.9 MW, 719 m2)
ftl_daughtercraft.momentum_matching: ordinary torch / external exchange (needs its own torch and remass)
ftl_daughtercraft.rarity: Loom-capable ships: a few dozen worldwide (CANON I 2.2, 5.4)
ftl_daughtercraft.verdict: Not a shuttle: the only certified relational plant is ~88 t with 10 kg Mc; canon gives no smaller design and calls the legacy smaller sizings non-governing. A daughtercraft is a second Loom-capable ship (~0.2-0.3 kt), too big for any bay option; carried externally it costs Wayfarer ~18-23% of ECON delta-v and joins Wayfarer's Loom domain (configuration lock). Plausible as a separate second ship acquired in play, not as Wayfarer equipment.

reasons: metric is long-baseline: one NORMAL ramp is ~0.40 million km of metric path (CANON II 9.1); Earth-Moon cannot fit a full cycle (9.3)
metric is not a close-combat dodge; torch owns tactical vector change (18A)
wake used as commandable reactionless thrust is a hard kill (21); FTL metric is a hard kill (5)
the plant is ~88 t and shared with Loom (3)
metric_manoeuvre.closest_legal: Osteon-light airframe + full-power torch with steerable magnetic nozzle (T/W up to ~2.5) and quiet electric fans; agile but never invisible: sensor primacy (18A) applies
